eps.o: Rachel and Nicky kick off their wedding week with a drive to his parents' secluded home — but end up taking a few detours.
When Rachel's wedding dress mysteriously goes missing, her in-laws are all too eager to provide an alternative.

eps.t: I Will Light You on Fire
eps.o: Rachel is tasked with taking down the Cunninghams' meal preferences — and discovers a lot more than she expected.
When a new chapter in her family history comes to light, Rachel learns that love means sometimes having to say you're sorry.

eps.t: I Think You Just Saved My Life
eps.o: Rachel and Nicky's romantic origin story is the talk of the rehearsal dinner — until they're forced to make a few revisions.
The bachelors hunt and the bachelorettes gather, but the party's definitely over.

eps.t: Something Living, Something Dead, Something Stolen, Something Red
eps.o: With the ceremony just an hour away, Rachel finds herself in serious need of a drink.
